query: WITH RECURSIVE ancestors AS (SELECT id,parent_id FROM b2b_units WHERE tenant=$1 AND company_id=$2 AND id=$3 UNION ALL SELECT u.id,u.parent_id FROM b2b_units u JOIN ancestors a ON u.id=a.parent_id WHERE u.tenant=$1 AND u.company_id=$2) SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ancestors) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ancestors WHERE id=$4) AS "v!"
